name: ALL ONE'S LIFE
source:
Main character is a freelance writer for a magazine. He cohabits with a girl who is his ardent supporter, but who has not become his lover in several years. He decides to move on with other women he encounters. He needs to make an important choice - to decide who really cares for him and who he himself cares for.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名为杂志撰稿的自由撰稿人。他与一名热情支持自己的少女共同生活了好几年，两人却始终没有成为恋人。他决定尝试与途中邂逅的其他女性发展关系。最终，他必须作出一个重要选择：究竟谁真正关心自己，而自己真正关心的人又是谁。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
